notes_for_editor: Dates agree across three sources (Idaho Fire Lookouts, firelookout.com, the Forest Service list). Staffing rests on one source, Idaho Fire Lookouts, which cites the book Fire Lookouts of the Northwest and gives no dates. That page spells the staffer's first name 'Everetee' in its header and 'Everete' in its body; the story follows the body. Staffing 'unstaffed' as of 1950 follows from the sourced ruin date; no source gives a staffing end date. Elevation is 5,708 ft per the Forest Service list and Idaho Fire Lookouts; the record's elevation_m is null. The access level is omitted: no source states an access rule, and the story says it is unknown whether the site is open; the drive-up label stays under visit. The 1950 date is in the Forest Service list's Sheep Mtn. row (its quote is the bare year, since the row's text is split across PDF lines). The Forest Service list also has a separate Eagle Point lookout nearby (two-story cabin 1935, later L-4 and R-6); do not confuse the two. A rental listing for a different 'Sheep Mountain Fire Lookout' (built 1950) turned up in search and was not used. No recent photo or visit report was found.
